annotations.title: Find the best loadout against a unit

description: Searches the attacking unit's legal wargear, with any attached leaders, for the loadout most likely to destroy the defender, then the most models destroyed, then the most wounds, as the simulator's Optimize does. Takes the same sides as simulate_combat; the attacker's choices and spreads are where the search starts, and model counts, enhancements and detachment upgrades stay fixed. mode ranks shooting followed by melee (combined), or one phase. Returns best and current, each with every attacking unit's choices and spreads ready for a roster pick or simulate_combat (a group left out keeps its default), its wargear by name, the weapon modes it used, and its odds; better says whether best beats current. exhaustive is true only when every legal loadout was checked; otherwise notes say why a better one may exist. Loadouts with rules the simulator cannot estimate are left out and named in notes. Takes up to about 20 seconds.

attached.description: Leaders or support units joined to the unit, from its canBeLedBy and canBeSupportedBy. A unit that joins one of these instead, such as Nork Deddog joining a Cadian Command Squad, goes after it.

choices.description: Wargear choices, choice key to option id from get_unit_options or a get_my_roster pick: pass that pick's entryId as unit with its models, choices and spreads unchanged. An enhancement among them needs the side's detachment named. Omitted, the unit takes its default loadout.

enhancement.description: Enhancement name from list_units for the side's detachment, given to this unit's character; it needs that detachment named.

models.description: Model count; must be a legal unit size. Defaults to the minimum size.

modelsLost.description: Models already destroyed; at least one must remain, so leave out a destroyed attached unit. Refused when its models carry different wargear, since which ones fell is unknown.

spreads.description: How many models take each option of a choice group, choice key to {option id: count}, for groups get_unit_options sets with spreads.

unit.description: Unit id, slug, name, or referenceId from list_units.

woundsLost.description: Wounds lost by the unit's one wounded model, fewer than its Wounds; damage-state rules follow it on a lone model.

modifiers.description: Situational modifiers the simulator page offers, such as { "all": { "cover": true, "hitModifier": -1 } }, { "melee": { "charged": true } }, or { "target": { "invulnerable": 4 } }. commandReroll spends one Command Re-roll per phase on the first failed hit, wound, or save roll, or the first single-die Attacks roll below its average; compare with a run without it to judge the CP.
